text:
Maya Chen: Received model bundle from partner S3 upload. Path: s3://redwood-ingest/new-models/zenith-alpha-2026/ — includes weights.tar.gz, tokenizer.json, manifest.json, and checksums.sha256
Omar Patel: Nice. Do we have the SHA-256 for weights.tar.gz already? can someone run `sha256sum` and paste output?
Maya Chen: I ran a quick one locally: `sha256sum weights.tar.gz` -> `3f7a9b2d...e4a` (pasted full in the manifest) but want infra to verify from the S3 object
artifact-bot: Automated provenance scan: manifest.json present, checksums.sha256 present, signature missing, KMS tag: redwood-ingest-customer-key, notarization: pending
Sophia Li: Signature missing is blocker for private registry onboarding. We should either sign with our ingestion signer or ask partner to provide signed artifact.
Ethan R.: For bring-up I can run a quick smoke: fp16 conversion test + 1-token perf on a sample sequence, and a small eval: perplexity on MMLU micro-subset + a few generation samples. ETA ~2h if I get access.
Omar Patel: Assigning tasks: @Ethan R. => smoke evals/quant targets; @Maya Chen => confirm S3 object-level checksums + set object lock; @Sophia Li => decide signing flow (ingest-signer vs partner).
Maya Chen: I'll run `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-ingest --key new-models/zenith-alpha-2026/weights.tar.gz --query {ETag:ETag}` and then `aws s3 cp s3://.../weights.tar.gz - | sha256sum` to verify. Posting result in 10m.
Omar Patel: Also add registry path reservation: `registry/zenith-alpha/2026-03-` and a metadata entry in our model-registry with `provenance: pending-signature, quant-targets: [fp16,int8], owner: eng-ml`
Sophia Li: On quantization: start fp16 baseline, then INT8-per-channel as an experiment. We'll gate INT8 by regression threshold: <= 2% delta on eval set and no catastrophic token errors on fuzz tests.
Ethan R.: Smoke results: fp16 load OK, end-to-end gen latency (1 prompt, seq=128) 220ms on dev GPU. Perplexity on micro-MMLU: 12.4. Sample outputs look sane. Running INT8 emulate now (using local quant bench).
CI-Bot: Quick CI note: storage policy requires object to have `kms:encrypt` tag and `provenance:manifest-v1` metadata before move to /registry. Failing checks will keep it in /quarantine.
Maya Chen: Verified S3 sha256 from object stream matches manifest: `3f7a9b2d...e4a` -> OK. Uploaded a copy to `s3://redwood-registry/incoming/zenith-alpha-2026/` with metadata set per CI-Bot.
Sophia Li: I'll handle signing with ingest-signer, but need legal to ack the partner terms. Pinged @legal in a separate DM.
Omar Patel: Once signed, we'll register a release tag and create a canary rollout on Dedicated capacity (low qps) with automatic rollback if regression triggers.
Ethan R.: INT8 quick pass shows small drop: perplexity -> 12.9 (~4%); generation fuzz found 1 prompt with repeated token loop. I'll add that prompt to the regression set and re-run quant tuning.
Maya Chen: Putting a short checklist here to close thread: 1) object checksum verified (done) 2) metadata/KMS set (done) 3) artifact signed (in progress) 4) basic fp16 smoke (done) 5) INT8 experiment (in progress) 6) register in model-registry (blocked until signature) 7) canary rollout config (todo)
Omar Patel: Fine. If signature not in 24h we fallback to partnering team to re-upload signed bundle. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sophia Li: Noted — I'll update the registry entry when signing completes.
artifact-bot: Notarization request queued (job id: nb-2026-00432). Will post result when available.
Ethan R.: tagging follow-ups in the tracker: MLD-1123 (smoke), MLD-1124 (INT8 tuning), MLD-1125 (canary).
